environment.description: Same Ktor service deployed behind AWS API Gateway (HTTP API type) with a request validator attached to the POST /api/v2/archives/extract route. The validator enforces a JSON Schema model that constrains the 'archiveBase64' field with a maxLength of 10485760 and pattern '^[A-Za-z0-9+/=]+$', and critically constrains 'extractPath' with pattern '^[a-zA-Z0-9_]{1,32}$' (no dots, slashes, or hyphens). However, the zip slip vulnerability is in the ZIP entry names inside the archive content itself, not in the extractPath field. The API Gateway integration uses a VPC Link to the internal ALB which has an additional AWS WAF WebACL with custom rule evaluating request body JSON paths — specifically a custom regex rule on $.archiveBase64 that decodes and inspects the first 8KB of the base64 payload checking for sequences matching path traversal patterns (../../) in PK zip local file headers. The WAF rule uses a regex pattern set with transformations: BASE64_DECODE followed by URL_DECODE, matching '\.\.[\\/]' against the decoded body content.

config.api_gateway: AWS HTTP API with request model validator
config.filesystem: local ephemeral storage, /var/app owned by appuser
